primary_antecedent.receiving_contribution: Antecedent for exact diffractive Tricomi realization. Independent exposition supplies an explicit high-Sobolev singular datum, actual two-jet lift, finite Hamilton-time endpoint proof, complete symbol-error argument and precise two-leg equality.

source_correspondence: D0 retains the precise general scalar hypothesis: a noncharacteristic boundary, real quadratic principal symbol, arbitrary complex lower terms, positive normal derivative at glancing and nonnegative boundary tangential symbol nearby. The conclusion concerns a continuous zero-Dirichlet distribution and a whole base neighborhood.

D1 proves the uniform linear normal lower bound, extends the principal symbol by a convex combination, retains the entire local symbol and explicitly completes the noncommuting normal square. All complex lower coefficients remain in the exact principal-type Cauchy model.

D2 writes an explicit Gaussian Fourier profile of high Sobolev order with one positive wavefront direction. Both weighted Gaussian moment bounds, local critical-order failure through its integer derivative, compact localization and linear coordinate transfer are supplied.

D3 lifts both actual jets with i x chi(x) phi, checks the full forcing class and applies the complete rough zero-jet existence proof. Hilbert-valued normal continuity and the explicit Fourier embedding inequality establish joint continuity and the actual zero boundary value.

D4 uses actual normal recovery and the canonical intrinsic extension, then the complete fixed-collar boundary-wavefront equality for the tangential pseudodifferential quadratic model. Tangentially smoothing residuals on all actual normal jets are genuinely smooth up to the boundary.

D5 proves that every interior characteristic reaches the boundary in finite Hamilton time. The integrable inverse-square-root estimates bound base displacement, both tangential norm ratios and the nonzero limiting covector. Compact continuation and full smooth Hamilton uniqueness remain valid at the degenerate root.

D6 applies ordinary interior propagation and closedness of the compressed front to identify every singular endpoint with the single prescribed boundary ray. The normalized Hamilton-time bound confines it to the intended local germ. No nowhere-vertical base-projection hypothesis is imposed.

D7 retains complete symbol agreement, all lower-order terms, actual normal jets and separated proper-kernel errors. It proves smoothness of original forcing on a full base neighborhood, not merely in one microlocal cone.

D8 applies strict diffractive scalar boundary propagation to the original operator and actual zero value trace. Both legs are forced singular; containment and equality are distinct proved steps. D9 compactly localizes and returns to the original manifold, stating the precise outside-neighborhood forcing limitation.

Three complete solutions verify the exact semicubic base cusp and regular ordinary Hamilton curve, both lift jets and every differentiated forcing term, and the endpoint-integrability threshold for the method. The original figure shows exact base, ordinary and compressed phase projections, with no wave-amplitude interpretation.

Forty-one exact algebraic checks, 208 parsed formulas, 31 displays and thirteen inspected lesson captures support the receiving review. These finite checks do not replace the analytic existence and wavefront arguments.
D10 supplies the explicit normalized Airy model announced in the closing remark, including entire series, polynomial derivative bounds, Fourier convergence and exact singular germ.
D11 supplies the nearby-elliptic realization with its actual possibly vertical interior turns, one full local canonical chart and the complete bounded-family Baire argument.
